notes: The peaceful-room guard returns silently before argument parsing or skill gates.
A non-fighting caller with no argument receives C's exact Bite who?! line.
A fighting caller with no argument uses FIGHTING(ch) and returns without output.
A missing room target uses the same exact Bite who?! punctuation.
C one_argument ignores trailing words after the target token.
Self-targeting emits the exact tongue-refusal line.
An ordinary player emits the actor, victim, and room love-bite act trio without damage.
A flagged but untransformed player receives the exact transformation refusal.
A higher-level immortal victim reaches C's Yeah, right. gate.
A player already flagged werewolf/vampire cannot be bitten.
Transformed werewolf damage is MIN(15, level), uses SKILL_BITE, starts combat, and waits two pulses.
A nonzero vampire bite roll deals no damage but directly adds victim level to eligible hunger conditions.
A zero vampire bite roll reaches damage(), waits two pulses, and still feeds from the victim.
The numbered SKILL_BITE message is emitted by the damage pipeline after the literal act preamble.
Common damage modifiers, combat enrollment, death, and resource handling remain owned by the combat-entry damage matrix.
